name: graphops-rpc
description: Read EVM and Bitcoin chain data with GraphOps RPC: query blocks, balances, contract calls and event logs through the RPC MCP server, and write bounded, recoverable JSON-RPC code.

interface.longDescription: Read EVM and Bitcoin chain data with GraphOps RPC: query blocks, balances, contract calls and event logs through the RPC MCP server, and write bounded, recoverable JSON-RPC code.
